test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

The person driving the car _____ control over the wheels and knocked her down.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e.** 'Lost'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is 2) **'lost'.**
